title: Chandra Finds Possible Origin of ‘Treble Clef’ Waves
caption:
Space just got musical. NASA’s Chandra X-Ray Observatory found a massive formation of radio waves shaped like a treble clef. It turns out this cosmic melody was written by a black hole outburst and a violent galaxy cluster collision.

Source: Nasa - Chandra Finds Possible Origin of ‘Treble Clef’ Waves
